scope: Aggregate presentation of completed exploratory studies. No raw recordings, trial-level EEG predictions or participant identifiers are included in the downloadable tables.

fly.method: Roundup outgoing weights set to zero; three recurrent gains, five paired input seeds, one second per run. Shared exogenous candidates with state-dependent refractory acceptance. Both candidate coupling and an execution correction were post-failure amendments, not preregistered.
fly.limits: Five input seeds are not animals. One model, neuron intervention, endpoint and input regime at three selected gains. No statistical significance, biological validation, novelty or full source-paper replication claimed. The source paper documents left-right inversion of the dataset and uses corrected biological sides. Genetic-driver coverage and historical cell-ID lineage remain unverified.

eeg.source: Scherer et al. (2015), https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0123727; BNCI2015-004, selected numeric classes 1, 2, 4.
eeg.method: Nine participants, 1080 earlier-session training trials and 1050 later-session evaluation trials. Three representations with fitted classifiers held fixed across two normalization modes. Verification passed after a verifier-metadata correction; no model was refitted. CSV accuracies are percentages.
eeg.limits: Previously inspected evaluation sessions. Descriptive exploratory result; no untouched-test, new-person, online, neural-mechanism, significance, novelty or competition-performance claim.
